route_title: Ge/ZnS Periodic Quarter-Wave Stack with 8 Pairs
compilation_rationale: Fixed 16-layer Ge/ZnS dielectric stack on CaF2. Initial thicknesses set to quarter-wave at 4.45 μm (~280/475 nm) with broad bounds [100, 600] nm. Target metrics directly constrain mean transmittance to maximize in passbands and minimize in stopbands. Coherent TMM with smatrix solves forward physics without material extrapolation.
